title: Portfolio value over time row
description: One row of out/<portfolio>/equity.csv and the <portfolio> equity Sheets tab: the portfolio's value at one point in time (every hour on the hour from the hour of its first activity, plus a last row at the report's as_of). Reporting only. Written by `nem report`; a reader must accept a source without this file (older 1.x engine) and hide what it would show.

schema_version.description: report layout version; the app accepts major 1

ts.description: the point in time valued (UTC); rows are in time order, the last one is the report's as_of

book_value_usd.description: starting balance + realized_pnl_usd + interest_usd: open positions at cost

realized_pnl_usd.description: realized P&L of trades settled (or exited) at or before ts; excluded trades left out

unrealized_pnl_usd.description: over trades open at ts (excluded left out): liquidation value at ts (recorded bids of the latest snapshot at or before ts, after the exit fee; uncovered contracts at $0) minus entry cost, for the marked ones; unmarked ones (stale book, closed market) count 0, i.e. at cost

value_usd.description: book_value_usd + unrealized_pnl_usd: the portfolio marked to market

open_positions.description: counted (not excluded) trades open at ts

open_unmarked.description: of open_positions, those with no fresh book at ts, counted at cost
